title: [CmdPal Dock] Auto-hidden dock reveals whenever the desktop gets focus (e.g. a click on the desktop)

judgment.rationale: Use existing competing upstream fixes and let maintainers choose; do not create a third design. Validate Win+D and desktop clicks separately from edge reveal.
evidence: The report gives clear top-edge auto-hide steps and a ShowDesktop/BringToTopMessage call path.
A contributor volunteered, and both #51555 and #51556 directly propose fixes. Neither is merged.
PR #51569 separately isolates the WinEvent helper.
Read #51556 patch: it removes RevealAutoHideDock from BringToTopMessage handling while retaining UpdateTopmostState.
Checked the state and file changes of #51555, #51556 and #51569.
judgment.recommended_action: Use the linked existing owner/fix; do not start a competing change.
